images.subject: The whole street of walking apartment blocks gathered in a city square at dusk, residents in slippers with lanterns and folding chairs walking to a long table with many tea cups and a small glowing intercom.
A tired block house with a radio antenna walking alone along a ring road worn into a groove in an abandoned industrial quarter (house no. 12).
A block house standing calmly in a glass greenhouse district, wheat on the roof, vines, children's laundry (house no. 23).
A block house curled up wrapped in cables in pale cyan light near the dispatch tower, as if asleep (house no. 4).
Kitchen at night: nine tea cups on the table and a tenth set on the floor before the glowing wall intercom; a woman at the window, a ginger cat.
An empty watchman's booth by a rusty gate, a whistle on a hook, the road leading to a broken iron bridge in the mist.
A mechanic with an angle grinder hesitating beside an intercom panel welded to a stairwell wall, sparks hanging.
An engineer at a radio desk watching cyan sparks arrange into dots and dashes.
A pot with a bare mint bush and a single green leaf under a lamp on a rainy windowsill, scissors nearby.
An accountant at a desk with a ledger, abacus, and a small envelope with a single coin, green banker's lamp.
A woman on the edge of her bed holding a complaint form while glowing musical notes drift out of the wall.
A young inventor grinning as a tiny intercom on microwave-oven legs takes its first step on a workbench.
A violinist in a corridor; amber sound waves from the violin and teal ones from the wall intercom weave into a duet.

note: The same model and the same style paragraph as the goal pictures (goal-prompts.json), so the scenes look like one set. The pictures of the bosses' last words reuse the district backdrops (ORIGIN_ART).
